newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PRESIDENT HAVEL TO ATTEND LISBON OSCE SUMMIT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PRESIDENT HAVEL TO ATTEND LISBON OSCE SUMMIT.

text.p: Czech President Vaclav Havel, who recently cancelled his remaining November schedule because of a bout with pneumonia, will attend a European security and human rights summit in early December, his office said on Tuesday.

Havel will take part in the summit of the 54 member countries in the Organisation for Security and Cooperation of Europe on Decmeber (OBSE) December 3 and 4 in Lisbon, his spokesman said in a statement.
On Monday, Havel cancelled a planned two-day state visit to Ukraine which was scheduled for Tuesday and Wednesday because of the pneumonia which struck him at the end of last week.

The pneumonia also caused Havel to pass on his tradition of laying anniversary flowers at a monument on Prague's National Avenue (Narodni Trida) where the Havel-led velvet revolution over the Communist government began seven years ago on Sunday.
